scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.test:e2e:index-harness: vite build --mode test-harness && BOOKHAND_TEST_HARNESS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/index-lifecycle.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:tutor-harness: vite build --mode test-harness && BOOKHAND_TEST_HARNESS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/tutor-guidance.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && npm run test:e2e:built && npm run verify:setup
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.serve:tailnet: npm run build && npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173
